## Change

Describe the concrete user problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List checks actually run, outcomes and any fixture/live-service boundaries. Link current evidence where useful.

## Review

- [ ] No secrets, local settings, private exports or outdated artifacts included.
- [ ] Ownership/security and migration implications reviewed where relevant.
- [ ] Product, technical, user docs and screenshots match the change.
- [ ] Remaining limitations and rollout/rollback implications stated.
